title: ui-confirm: create PersonaDisplay component
description: Create a PersonaDisplay component that shows the user persona context relevant to the problem being confirmed. This component renders persona attributes, expertise areas, and contextual information that helps frame the problem validation from the appropriate perspective.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL display persona name and role prominently
THE SYSTEM SHALL show relevant expertise areas as tags or badges

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a persona is associated with the current problem
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL render the persona details in a visually distinct section
THE SYSTEM SHALL refresh the display with new persona information

unwanted.condition: IF no persona is associated with the problem
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT display a broken or empty persona section
unwanted.because: missing persona context should be handled gracefully

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT show placeholder text that appears as actual content
unwanted.because: users must distinguish between real data and placeholders

preconditions: Persona service or data source must be accessible
Problem context may or may not have an associated persona
postconditions: Persona information is displayed in a consistent, readable format
Missing persona is handled with appropriate fallback UI
invariants: Persona display never modifies the underlying persona data
Visual hierarchy places persona as supporting context, not primary focus

happy: Given a problem with associated persona, when rendered, then displays persona name, role, and expertise
Given a persona with multiple expertise areas, when rendered, then shows all areas as formatted badges
Given persona context updates, when re-rendered, then reflects the updated information
error: Given a problem without persona, when rendered, then shows a neutral state or skip indicator
Given an invalid persona reference, when rendered, then displays fallback without crashing
Given a partially loaded persona, when rendered, then shows available data with loading indicators for missing fields

phase_2: Create PersonaDisplay component with persona prop
Add badge rendering for expertise areas
Add fallback UI for missing persona
Add loading state for partial data
